name: Can You Change a Kitchen Remodel After It Starts?

mainEntity.name: Can I change my kitchen remodel plan after work has started?
mainEntity.text: Can I change my kitchen remodel plan after work has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can change a kitchen remodel plan after work starts, but every change has a cost in time, money, or both. Some changes are small, like choosing a different faucet or hardware finish. Others can affect cabinets, utilities, ordering, and inspections. In Los Angeles County, changes may also trigger permit revisions if the scope shifts enough. The safest approach is to finalize as much as possible before demolition begins, especially layout, appliance sizes, cabinet details, and lighting plans. If a change becomes necessary, ask for a written change order that shows the price impact and any schedule adjustment before approving it. That keeps the project controlled and reduces the chance of disputes later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but changes after construction begins usually cost more and can delay the schedule. Late changes may require new materials, revised permits, rework, or added labor, so the best time to make decisions is before demolition starts.
